findings.description: The commit title says Request.headers moves back to Mapping, but the diff also changes the value type from `str | bytes` to `object` in both the attribute annotation and `HeadersType`. This is a broader loosening than the title announces.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller passes `headers={'X': 1}` or any non-str/bytes value. Mechanism: the type checker now accepts it, although header validation and sending code expects str or bytes. Impact: the mistake is no longer caught statically and surfaces at runtime as an InvalidHeader error.
